missing.why: Players may type him, but his base range is melee (Data Dragon), so correctly excluded; not missing.
Iconic stealth champion but melee by base range; correctly excluded. Expect wrong guesses, not a data fix.
Brushmaker only makes brush; Ivern is not Invisible/Camouflaged, and the term excludes brush. Not missing.

disputable.why: Her invisibility is only Mirror Image's passive (brief stealth at low health); many players don't think of it as 'can become invisible'.
Only after evolving Supercharge (E); the Rule allows it but some players argue unevolved Kai'Sa can't.
Shapesplitter (W) makes her briefly Invisible; players more readily think of her disguise, which is not invisibility.

wording.why: 'Ranged' is defined by base attack range, which players can't see; borderline 300-325 ranged champions may surprise.
wording.suggestion: Keep the Rule; consider a reveal note that ranged = base attack range 300+.

fun.why: Twitch/Teemo/Vayne are easy openers; Senna, Neeko, LeBlanc, Aurora reward knowledge. 9 answers is small but varied.

champion:Twitch.why: Ambush is the stealth ADC everyone knows.

champion:Teemo.why: Guerrilla Warfare camouflage is a meme.

champion:Vayne.why: Final Hour + Tumble stealth is iconic.

champion:Akshan.why: Going Rogue camouflage is his signature.

champion:Kaisa.why: Evolved E invis is known to ADC players.

champion:Senna.why: Curse of the Black Mist camouflage is remembered by bot/support players.

champion:Neeko.why: Players think disguise first; W invis is secondary.

champion:Aurora.why: Newer champion; her W invisibility is not widely known.

gemCandidates.why: Camouflage from her E is an 'oh, of course' once revealed and a fair number of players get it.
Shapesplitter's stealth clone is recognisable on reveal.
Mirror Image stealth is a classic mechanic most forget.
